hardware: Windows 11 build 26200; AMD Ryzen 7 9800X3D (8C/16T); 96 GiB installed RAM; RTX 4080 SUPER.
runtime: WeChat 4.1.15.13 / OCR plugin 8096; SDK v0.2.1 official Windows release.
method: 50 game ROIs from two games + 48 generated text images + 4 blank images. Full detection+recognition through MaaFramework; threshold=0; no expected or replacement filtering. Unicode NFKC and whitespace removal; case and punctuation retained. Read fragmented lines in spatial row/left-to-right order using the same rule for all models. Five timed repeats per pre-cropped ROI; 15 per full screen. Separate model processes. PPOCR ONNX Runtime CPU 4 threads per model or DirectML device 0 (RTX 4080 SUPER); WeChat vendor defaults; all images preloaded. Memory is incremental process-tree Windows private commit including full-screen inference, not GPU VRAM.
